packageRules.description: First-party Tailor packages: skip the release-age delay inherited from the shared preset. The gate guards against compromised third-party republishes, not packages we publish ourselves.
Type definitions move together and are build-time only. react/react-dom types are pulled out into the react group below.
oxlint and oxfmt ship from the same project and are pinned together in the pnpm catalog — lint/format toolchain.

react + react-dom share an exact version and their @types track major.minor. packages/core declares both as peerDependencies, so raising the floor is a consumer-facing breaking change — always review. Must stay after the type-definitions rule to reclaim @types/react.
@base-ui/react — runtime UI primitives the component library is built on. Review: behaviour and a11y changes are not caught by CI.
tailwindcss and its postcss/vite adapters share an exact version (same monorepo). Review — minor bumps can change generated CSS, which CI does not catch.
@testing-library packages are versioned independently but are only meaningful together.
vitest core and its subpackages move in lockstep; happy-dom is the environment they run against.
The Playwright npm package and browser bundles must move together or E2E fails to launch.
vite and the plugins that hook its build pipeline — a plugin bump alone can break against an older vite.
tsdown depends on rolldown — bundler for the vite-plugin and catalogue builds.
@changesets/cli and the changelog generators must stay in sync — release tooling, review.
Group all GitHub Actions bumps into one PR. Digests are pinned by the shared preset; majors are held by :approveMajorUpdates.
Held below a known-breaking major — see the vite 8 / plugin-react 6 incompatibility.

Gated by minimumReleaseAgeExclude in pnpm-workspace.yaml: pnpm's own maturity check blocks these until a matching exclude entry is hand-added, which Renovate cannot write. If CI fails at install with a trust/maturity error, add the entry before re-running.
